title: ABG: acid–base reading

findings.where: src/diagrams/abg.jsx — MODEL_TOLERANCE, abgConsistency(), and the computed worked-example verdict
findings.title: The consistency tolerance admits a false fully compensated reading
findings.problem: interpretAbg({ ph: 7.35, paco2: 60, hco3: 30 }) passes validation and returns fully compensated respiratory acidosis. Its implied pH is approximately 7.322. Even allowing whole-number rounding of PaCO₂ and HCO₃⁻ and the analyzer constants listed in the source, the highest compatible unrounded pH is approximately 7.336—insufficient to report 7.35. The symmetric +0.015 allowance incorrectly permits this: the stated analyzer variation does not shift pH upward by that amount. An inconsistent triad therefore becomes authoritative teaching at the acidemia/normal boundary.
findings.fix: Derive asymmetric consistency bounds directly from the supported pK and CO₂-solubility ranges, together with reporting precision, rather than adding a symmetric model tolerance. Add this exact triad as a regression test requiring a recheck verdict, not a compensation label.

findings.where: Step "limits" — caption and narration versus the rules panel in images 1, 7, 9, and 15
findings.title: The spoken algorithm omits its applicability limits
findings.problem: The panel limits respiratory-acidosis estimates to PaCO₂ up to about 80 and includes the bicarbonate guardrails, but the caption and narration give the equations without those restrictions. For example, pH 7.15 / PaCO₂ 100 / HCO₃⁻ 34 fits the acute equation as narrated, while the interpreter explicitly returns compensation not evaluable at that PaCO₂. A student following the spoken instructions can reach a reading the tool refuses.
findings.fix: Include the interpreter's approximately 80-mmHg applicability limit in both caption and narration. Also state the acute bicarbonate and respiratory-alkalosis bicarbonate cautions, preserving their approximate—not absolute—wording. Keep the spoken method aligned with the displayed rules and computed verdicts.

assessment: Hold publication. The consistency check admits an internally contradictory gas and labels it fully compensated. The limits narration also omits restrictions that the displayed rules and interpreter enforce.
